bhisamuḷālaṃ gaṇhitvā, agamaṃ buddhasantikaṃ, tañ'ca buddhassa pādāsiṃ, pasanno sehi pāṇibhi.
atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassī bodhisatto aparena samayena eko gaṇamhā vūpakaṭṭho vihāsi, aññen'eva tāni caturāsīti pabbajitasahassāni agamaṃsu, aññena maggena vipassī bodhisatto.
atha kho therā bhikkhū yathāvihāraṃ agamaṃsu. āyasmā'pi mahako sakaṃ vihāraṃ agamāsi.
anagārā mayaṃ, gahapati. agamamha kho te, gahapati, gehaṃ, tattha n'eva dānaṃ alatthamha na paccakkhānaṃ, añña'd'atthu akkosam'eva alatthamhā'ti.

agamāsi kho, bhikkhave, so kummo taṃ padesaṃ. tam'enaṃ luddo papatāya vijjhi.
atha kho therā bhikkhū yathāvihāraṃ agamaṃsu. āyasmā'pi mahako sakaṃ vihāraṃ agamāsi.
sv'āhaṃ idha pañca sikkhā karitvā, paṭipajjitvā tathāgatassa dhamme, dvepatham'agamāsiṃ coramajjhe, te maṃ tattha vadhiṃsu bhogahetu.
evaṃ gacchante kāle ekaṃ nigamagāmaṃ agamāsi.
puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā maggo gato hoti. tassa evaṃ hoti, ahaṃ kho maggaṃ agamāsiṃ. maggaṃ kho pana me gacchantassa kāyo kilanto. hand'āhaṃ nipajjāmī'ti.
